Subject: Vendor docs for purchase activation - HarborCloud

Hi Naomi,

We're ready to be onboarded into Redwood's vendor system and are looking to receive the PO for the upcoming integration work. Attached are our initial tax documents: a signed W-8BEN-E (we're an Ireland-registered holding) and a recent bank letter showing account ownership.

Quick summary of attachments:
- HarborCloud_W-8BEN-E_signed.pdf (signed by CFO)
- HarborCloud_bank_letter_20260816.pdf (bank stamp, account name HarborCloud Ltd)

Let us know if you need additional evidence (certified company registry extract, apostille, etc.). We're available for a quick remote notarization session if Redwood requires notarized signature.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance
HarborCloud Inc.
attachments: HarborCloud_W-8BEN-E_signed.pdf (application/pdf), HarborCloud_bank_letter_20260816.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborcloud.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T15:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for purchase activation - HarborCloud

Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few items from procurement/tax that we need before we can create the purchase account and issue a PO: 

1) Confirm legal entity name exactly as registered (company registry extract preferred). The name on the bank letter appears as "HarborCloud Ltd" but the W-8BEN-E lists the holding entity as "HarborCloud Holdings Ltd" — our system flagged a name/TIN alignment check.

2) For foreign entities we require a completed W-8BEN-E with the signatory capacity clearly indicated (e.g., "Authorized signatory - CFO"). If possible, please re-submit the form with the signatory's government ID redacted except for name and signature line.

3) A bank letter is acceptable evidence; we need the bank letter to include the account holder name and bank contact stamp/email. If the bank letter is in a different legal name than the W-8, please provide a certificate of registration or a notarized affiliation document clarifying the relationship.

4) If you prefer DocuSign for the corrected W-8, here's our template link for remote execution: https://docusign.com/template/3f2a8b.

If you can provide the corrected W-8 and either the company registry extract or an apostilled certificate showing the ownership chain, we can move to conditional PO creation. If there's still a name/TIN mismatch afterward, Tax (cc'ing Karthik) will advise whether a conditional/escrow PO is acceptable.

Thanks — copying Jordan for procurement lead visibility.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
